Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride

South Portland, ME

Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride is a road group ride in South Portland, ME. It meets Wednesdays, 5:30 pm, starting at South Portland High School parking lot. Pace: A 20–26 mph no waiting; B group behind.

About the Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride group ride

Maine's biggest club's Wednesday hammer ride. The A group leaves at 5:30 and does not wait; if you get dropped, fall in with the B group. Plan on a hard night either way, with a sprint at the end for those who want it.
